top_events.title: Russian vessel hit by suspected Ukrainian drone at Libya's Benghazi port
top_events.label: Ukrainian drone strikes Russian ship in Libya
top_events.summary: A suspected Ukrainian drone attack caused an explosion on a Russian warship docked at Libya's Benghazi naval base. The vessel was en route back to Russia when struck.

top_events.title: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
top_events.label: Russian ship towed after drone attack Finland
top_events.summary: Finnish defence forces say Ukraine likely behind the drone strike on a Russian vessel in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday. The damaged ship was towed away from the area.

top_events.title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
top_events.label: COP31 climate summit collapses without deal
top_events.summary: The UN climate summit in Turkey ended without agreement after countries failed to reach consensus on tackling climate change, marking the first such failure since 2009.

short_summary: Russia launches major air attack on Kyiv bridges

most_significant_event.label: Russia launches major air attack on Kyiv bridges
most_significant_event.summary: Russia conducted one of its largest air attacks targeting Kyiv infrastructure in retaliation for Ukrainian strikes on the Crimean Bridge, escalating regional conflict.
